issues.reason: Possessive / genitive NP licenses Possession only for an 's, a possessive pronoun or a genitive of-phrase, and "Republican efforts" has none, so the atom asserts an ownership link the text never states.

A modifier never mints a referent (a noun modifier is not exposed at all, an adjectival one only as a genus or a distributed property), so the person-group sk_republican_1 is an invented entity, and letting republican be a person kind there while it is a property of each effort in statement 4 makes an effort a republican person under the engine's member-inheritance.

The connective / noun-complement obliques relate eventualities by SYMBOL ((To sk_kneel_1 sk_check_1)), and sealing a proposition as a term argument is defined only for attitudes, embedded questions, imperatives and counterfactuals, so an (Or (And ...) (And ...)) term in the To slot is ill-typed for that head.

Disjunction requires the (Or ...) around only the varying constituent, reserving wide bundle scope for "independent clauses that share nothing", whereas here the theme (sk_return_1), the To link and the agent are all shared and only the event class varies.
Same root defect as index 2: with both events sealed inside a relation argument neither class nor role atom is reachable, while the return event they govern is emitted at top level.

gaps_confirmed: a bare plural NP in a non-subject, specific-reference position ("part of failed Republican efforts") - the determiner rule for plurals is stated for SUBJECTS only

a to-infinitive complement on a nominalization ("efforts to force ...") - Complements of nouns and adjectives covers of-phrases and "for" arguments, so the (To <noun> <event>) shape is only an analogy
new_gaps: a definite plural proper noun naming party members ("the Democrats") - nothing chooses between a group witness over a lowercased kind and a name-derived symbol plus its mandatory Name fact

the implicit agent of a nominalization supplied only by an attributive modifier ("Republican efforts" - who does the forcing) has no licensed carrier once the modifier is barred from minting a referent
repair_summary: Dropped the invented person group (GroupOf sk_republican_1 republican) and the unlicensed (Possession sk_effort_1 sk_republican_1), and with them the two Agent atoms that referenced that symbol, leaving the forcing/enticing agentless as an agentless passive omits its Agent. Rebuilt the purpose atom as one asserted (And ...) fact with the (Or ...) narrowed to the varying event class and the shared To link and Theme as ordinary conjuncts, so To again relates eventuality symbols and nothing is sealed. Kept (Member $x republican) in the member-distribution rule, which is unambiguously a property of the efforts once the person group is gone.
notes: The reviewer's third gap dissolves under the repair - the Or no longer sits under a relation argument, and "the vase is red or blue" is the precedent for a disjunction over one referent's class atom. The fine/effort/democrat groups, failed as a participial adjective, and the object-control return event with no tense were left untouched.
